title: MINOR / AAPS language change
body:
Not sure if this was issued before. If I set AAPS language to English, the UI is in English. If I set it the to French, the UI is in French (phone language is French).

But, if I set it to English then set it to Phone default, the UI stays in English. The main page graphs has the French definitions but that's all.

comments.body: It recommended to restart AAPS after language change.

Ok. Is it possible to show a message after language change "Please restart AAPS" ? 

OTOH, language is something most people will never change.
latest dev seems to behave correctly
